settings.poll_ms.label: Poll interval
settings.poll_ms.description: Milliseconds between asking Hyprland, on top of reacting to its events. Rolling the tape by gesture announces nothing, so this is what catches it. 0 disables the poll.
settings.monitor.label: Monitor
settings.monitor.description: Whose workspaces the dial describes: the monitor this bar is on, or whichever one has focus.
settings.shape.label: Shape
settings.shape.description: The dial's outline. Either way it's cut on the diagonals into four quadrants, one per compass point.
settings.size.label: Size
settings.size.description: Diameter or side, in pixels. The bar clips anything taller than itself.
settings.radius.label: Corner radius
settings.divider.label: Divider width
settings.divider.description: The lines between quadrants, in pixels. 0 removes them.
settings.badge_size.label: Badge size
settings.badge_size.description: Diameter of the circle behind the hop count, in pixels. 0 means half the dial.
settings.font_size.label: Digit size
settings.font_size.description: Font size of the hop count, in pixels. 0 means 0.8 of the badge.
settings.font_family.label: Font
settings.font_family.description: For the hop count. The widget is drawn as an SVG, so this is resolved by fontconfig, not the bar. Empty means sans-serif.
settings.fill.label: Dial color
settings.fill.description: The unlit quadrants. Default is a faint on_surface.
settings.workspace_color.label: Workspace color
settings.workspace_color.description: The north/south quadrant, lit when there's an occupied workspace that way. Default is primary.
settings.home_color.label: Home color
settings.home_color.description: The quadrant facing the home workspace, whatever else is that way. Default is secondary.
settings.window_color.label: Window color
settings.window_color.description: The west/east quadrant, lit when a window sits off-screen that way. Default is tertiary.
settings.divider_color.label: Divider color
settings.divider_color.description: The lines between quadrants. Default is shadow.
settings.badge_color.label: Badge color
settings.badge_color.description: The filled circle behind the hop count. Default is surface.
settings.text_color.label: Digit color
settings.text_color.description: For the hop count. Default is on_surface.
settings.special_fill.label: Dial color (special workspace)
settings.special_fill.description: While a special workspace is up. Default is a faint tertiary.
settings.special_workspace_color.label: Workspace color (special workspace)
settings.special_workspace_color.descrip: As above, while a special workspace is up. Default is tertiary.
settings.special_home_color.label: Home color (special workspace)
settings.special_home_color.description: As above, while a special workspace is up. Default is primary.
settings.special_window_color.label: Window color (special workspace)
settings.special_window_color.descriptio: While a special workspace is up, the west/east quadrants judge its windows instead. Default is secondary.
settings.special_divider_color.label: Divider color (special workspace)
settings.special_divider_color.descripti: As above, while a special workspace is up. Default is shadow.
